1.name: SW
1.hint: switch output, the drain of the internal N-channel MOSFET: to the inductor and the Schottky diode's anode (the diode's cathode to VIN); a fast switching node – keep its tracks short (p. 2, 11, 14)

2.name: GND
2.hint: signal and power ground, directly to the ground plane (p. 2, 14)

3.name: DIM
3.hint: on/off and dimming: below 0.3 V off (standby 95 µA), at least 2.5 V and below 5 V full current; DC 0.5 … 2.5 V dims (IOUT = 0.1 V × VDIM / (2.5 V × RS)), PWM 100 Hz … 20 kHz; internal 200 kΩ to an internal 5 V – floating is on; a capacitor to GND adds about 0.8 ms/nF soft start (p. 3, 5, 11, 12)

4.name: CSN
4.hint: current sense input: RS from VIN to CSN sets the LED current, IOUT = 0.1 V / RS (RS ≥ 0.082 Ω); absolute maximum +0.3 … −6.0 V with respect to VIN; connect VIN and CSN directly to the two ends of RS, no other current in those tracks (p. 2, 11, 14)

5.name: VIN
5.hint: input supply, bypassed locally: a low-ESR X7R or X5R capacitor close to the pin, at least 4.7 µF if the DC source is close, more than 100 µF behind a rectifier; no Y5V (p. 2, 12)

needs.source: China Resources Powtech PT4115 data sheet PT4115_DS Rev EN_2.9, p. 12 capacitor selection: 'A minimum value of 4.7uF is acceptable if the DC input source is close to the device'; for a rectified AC input more than 100 µF

hints: LED current IOUT = 0.1 V / RS, valid for RS ≥ 0.082 Ω (1.2 A); the mean sense threshold of the A type (PT4115B89E) is 95 / 98 / 101 mV, of the B type (PT4115B89E-B) 99 / 102 / 105 mV (p. 1, 3, 11)
the input must stay above the LED string: the switch's on time is L × ΔI / (VIN − VLED − Iavg × (RS + rL + RSW)), RSW 0.6 Ω nominal (p. 12–13)
inductor 27 … 100 µH recommended; by load current: above 1 A 27–47 µH, 0.8–1 A 33–82 µH, 0.4–0.8 A 47–100 µH, up to 0.4 A 68–220 µH, saturation current 1.3–1.5 times the load current (p. 12)
Schottky diode with a peak current rating above the coil's peak current and a continuous rating above the load current; mind its leakage above 85 °C (p. 13)
power dissipation is highest at the lowest supply voltage; thermal shutdown at 160 °C, recovery at 140 °C (p. 4, 13, 14)
